text: TeachingObjectives The BBA programme combines strong functional training with intensive exposure to communication skills, computer applications, plus other social science and/or science subjects. To help student obtain knowledge and ability of business management, economic management and enterprise management, and enable student to deal with all kinds of business management related work in all kinds of organizations. Main Courses Compulsory majors: Choose from one of the following majors: Business Design and Innovation Human Resource Management Information Systems Marketing Wealth Management Optional majors: Economics Finance Quantitative Finance Duration 4 years Degree Awarded Qualified student will be granted Bachelor Degree of Business Administration by The University of Hong Kong Future Career The BBA programmes are designed for students intending to pursue a career in fields such as accounting, advertising, banking, brand management, customer relationship management, finance, human resource management, information systems, investment, marketing research and marketing management.
